text:
Priya: Heads-up — quick thread to design a Grafana panel to correlate PCIe/NET retransmit spikes with GPU inlet temps and allocation tiling. Seeing odd evictions in us-west racks this morning.
Alex: Can you drop a sample PromQL? We already scrape pcie_retransmits_total and node_temp_celsius.
Priya: Sketch: stacked rows: PCIe retransmits, nvlink latency p99, net tx bytes burst, node_temp. Example queries: 
```
sum(rate(pcie_retransmits_total[5m])) by (rack)
avg_over_time(node_temp_celsius[5m])
sum(rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total[1m])) by (rack)
```
Morgan: Add kvcache_hit_rate too — last eviction incident matched a cache miss spiral.
Jin: Agree but alerts will be noisy. Recommend recording rule `gpu_fleet_pcie_retransmit_rate` and an alert with `for: 15m`.
Priya: The dashboard should help SRE triage thermal vs network vs tiling. Include annotations: recent kube-eviction events, capacity commits, and config rollouts.
Alex: Layout idea: row1 telemetry (temps, pcie, nvlink), row2 network (tx, queue length, packet drops), row3 derived correlations + top offending pods per rack. Will add sparkline overlays.
Morgan: Alert tuning proposal: fire if retransmit_rate > 50/s sustained AND node_temp_celsius > 82 AND net_burst_bytes/s > 1e9 for 10m. Scope to `cluster=prod` to cut noise.
Jin: I'll add a templating var `rack` (regex for regions) and `tenant`; include runbook link and slack oncall mention in alert message.
ops-bot: deploybot: opened PR #4127 for new recording rules; CI green.
Priya: Before shipping, backlog an opt: computed "headroom" metric combining queued requests + scheduled pods so scaling bursts aren't misclassified as anomalies.
Alex: Deploying panel draft to staging: https://grafana.internal/d/ABC123/gpu-netflow-tiling-eviction-triage — please validate with Feb/Sep incidents.
Morgan: :thumbsup: I'll run historical queries and sanity-check alerts against incident windows.
Jin: If staging shows false positives, we'll add a debouncing rule or lightweight anomaly scorer later.
Priya: Great. @oncall please keep an eye on us-west for the next 48h after the staging deploy.
